verdict.rationale: CRM sync is a fair question for a meeting-notes product, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a native HubSpot, Salesforce, or Attio integration that attaches notes to contact or deal records. The only related items are webhooks feeding Zapier and a GraphQL API. Those are developer building blocks or user-side workarounds, not the product's own CRM sync, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a sales lead, meeting notes and summaries sync automatically onto the right contact and deal records in my CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio)
